fields.title: Blog Application
fields.description:
Developed a blogging platform that allows users to publish blog posts and read content shared by other users.
• Implemented backend functionality using Django to manage blog creation, content retrieval, and database operations.
• Integrated MySQL for persistent data storage and Bootstrap for responsive interface components.

opportunity.

fields.name: Rohit Kumar Rawat
fields.short_intro: I'm Rohit Kumar Rawat, a Computer Science and Technology student passionate about Python Backend Development, Full-Stack Development and AI. I enjoy building web applications, solving coding challenges and exploring emerging technologies. I'm focused
fields.description:
Hi, I'm **Rohit Kumar Rawat**, a Computer Science and Technology student at IES University, Bhopal.

I'm an aspiring Python Backend Developer with an interest in Full-Stack Development and Artificial Intelligence. I work with Python, Django, MySQL, HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and I'm continuously strengthening my skills in Data Structures and Algorithms, Machine Learning and Generative AI.

I've built projects including a Django-based Blog Application and a Stock Prediction Portal using Machine Learning. I enjoy solving programming problems, exploring new technologies and turning ideas into practical applications.

My goal is to become a skilled software engineer who builds scalable, efficient and useful technology solutions.
fields.career_objective:
To pursue a challenging opportunity as a Software Developer or Python Backend Developer where I can apply my knowledge of Python, Django, databases, Data Structures and Algorithms, and modern web technologies.

I aim to continuously improve my problem-solving and software development skills while gaining practical industry experience. My long-term objective is to contribute to the development of scalable backend systems and intelligent applications using Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.
